data.summary: Finance and Automation professional with experience in combining hands-on analytical and automation skills with real finance fluency – bringing efficiency and cutting manual efforts at global financial firms. Strong expertise in Python, SQL, and Power BI for data analysis, process transformation, automation, and leadership-ready storytelling. Proven partner in strengthening controls, driving process improvement, system migration and collaborating with senior internal and external stakeholders in high pressure environments. Adept at using AI tools to accelerate analysis, code, and reporting workflows.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
EXL Services | Manager – Business Analyst Developer – Finance Systems (09/2026 - Present)
American Express | Business Analyst – Reporting and Governance (Contract) (10/2025 – 09/2026)
Designed and implemented Airtable automated workflows and dashboards, eliminating manual tracking processes and significantly


improving team operational efficiency. Led data migration from Cornerstone to Oracle ERP, including data mapping, validation, and UAT testing to ensure seamless transition with full data integrity. Analysed large, complex datasets, performed gap analysis and root cause analysis using Power Query and PowerBI to assess data completeness, consistency, and risk exposure for internal governance and audit reviews.
BlackRock Inc (02/2021 – 06/2025)
Associate - Finance Information & Analytics • Developed and maintained Power BI dashboards and financial models to analyse and report on key metrics (AUM, Net New Business,


Base Fee Revenue), directly informing forecasting, budgeting, and P&L analysis for senior management. Collaborated with management and client service teams to define requirements and deliver KPI dashboards, enabling efficient reporting of complex financial data. Streamlined revenue operations by building a centralized fee repository and resolving portfolio rate calculation gaps in Cognos TM1, improving accuracy by 50% and reducing manual processes.
Associate/Analyst -Technology & Operations • Managed risk and optimized processes in outsourcing post-trade services to global banks, boosting efficiency and compliance. •
Facilitated performance communication with 200+ stakeholders via Qualtrics and Python, ensuring smooth outsourcing and issue resolution. Conducted quarterly business reviews and automated reporting using SQL and Power BI, improving precision, and cutting manual effort by 70%. Spearheaded KY3P audit remediation migration, enhancing third-party risk oversight for 50+ vendors and aligning controls with internal audit standards.


Royal Bank of Scotland | Advisor - Global Financial Services (Contract) (07/2019 – 02/2021) • Executed journal entries, vendor invoices, bank transfers, subsequent reconciliations and prepared audit-ready documentation to ensure regulatory compliance.
Managed high-volume month-end reconciliations across GL accounts, coordinating with finance and treasury to resolve payment exceptions, optimize cash flow, and reduce risk.
Managed functional testing and identified 50+ system and data integrity issues during SAP to Oracle migration, enabling seamless

financial process transitions. Produced management information and Profit & Loss (P&L) reports, including processing and error reports, in collaboration with the Financial Control team to support operational P&L analysis.
Barclays | Process Advisor – Corporate & Investment Banking (09/2017 – 10/2018) • Processed high-volume multi-currency payments with 100% accuracy, ensuring compliance with IBAN, SWIFT, and banking standards. Led user acceptance testing (UAT) and SOP updates for the Standing Order platform migration, improving process efficiency.

Fidelity International | Associate – Banking, Reconciliation & Controls (12/2015 – 08/2017) • Executed trade account reconciliation and settlement with accurate ledger entries and bank transfers, ensuring full compliance with FCA client money regulations. Reconciled 3,000+ ISA transactions with 100% accuracy using internal settlement systems XTRAC, GFAS and JD Edwards, ensuring timely and error-free year-end processing. Improved accuracy by 50% using a financial model to identify ledger and cash breaks, resolving via bank transfers to ensure smooth
•
•
month end reconciliation.
